source_claim: The Honkai Impact 3rd publisher's official HoYoLAB post is titled "Rita's New S-rank Battlesuit ‘Miss Espionage’ Debuts" and states that Rita's new S-rank battlesuit Miss Espionage debuts in v8.6. This explicitly identifies the current Miss Espionage member as a Rita battlesuit in Honkai Impact 3rd.
notes: This source explicitly proves the Miss Espionage-to-Rita relation and that Rita is presented in the Honkai Impact 3rd v8.6 game context. Other Rita campaign variants are not inferred from this announcement.
